commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Garza Zol, Plague Queen ({4}{U}{B}{R} 5/5 legendary Vampire Noble, flying and haste; Coldsnap csp, released 2006-07-21; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Whenever a creature Garza dealt damage to this turn dies, she gets a +1/+1 counter; whenever she deals combat damage to a player we may draw. Plan: a Bracket 4 equipment Voltron (21 Equipment in the candidate) using deathtouch (Basilisk Collar, Quietus Spike), Garza-sourced removal and sweepers (Fall of the Hammer, Soul's Fire, Chandra's Ignition, Nova Flame, now Giantfall) to grow her, Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar and Curiosity to spread and draw, commander damage, Grafted Exoskeleton infect, and Sword of Feast and Famine or The Reaver Cleaver with Aggravated Assault for extra combats.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized), unchanged. Game Changers: 9 in baseline and candidate (Ancient Tomb, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Grim Monolith, Jeska's Will, Mana Vault, Rhystic Study, Vampiric Tutor). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: 3 -> 3 complete combos (3750-5039 The Reaver Cleaver + Aggravated Assault; 900-3750 Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault, both need Garza to connect; 2822-3681 Kediss + Grafted Exoskeleton poisons each opponent); almost-included 86 -> 86. No compact two-card instant win; owner rejected compact combo.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Garza's Oracle: Lizard Blades doubles her combat-draw and kill-counter triggers; Giantfall is Garza-sourced removal that grows her; the two MDFCs keep spell slots for Garza pieces. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis decks, baseline -> candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Nicol Bolas 61 -> 58; Lord of Tresserhorn 50 -> 47; Obeka, Brute Chronologist 48 -> 46; Nicol Bolas, the Ravager 46 -> 44; Edward Kenway 46 -> 44. None of the four adds appears in those five decks; the deck stays an equipment Voltron built on Garza's own damage-death counter and combat-draw text. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Lightning Greaves, Embercleave, Bident of Thassa, Ophidian Eye, Frantic Search, Waltz of Rage, Go for the Throat, Soul Shatter, the Vampire tribal cards, Sword of Truth and Justice, the pinger class Viridian Longbow / Gorgon's Head, Unscythe, Vorpal Sword, extra fast mana and compact combo) are not re-added; Fire Whip appears only in a rejected staged list. No owner keep or owner addition is cut by the research four.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (99 rows, all 1x).
Roles:
- 38 lands in the baseline: Ancient Tomb, Bojuka Bog, Cavern of Souls, City of Brass, Command Beacon, Command Tower, Exotic Orchard, Luxury Suite, Mana Confluence, Morphic Pool, Otawara, Soaring City, Plaza of Heroes, Rogue's Passage, Shizo, Death's Storehouse, Takenuma, Abandoned Mire, Training Center, Xander's Lounge, 4 original duals, 3 shocks, Shivan Reef, Sulfurous Springs, Underground River, 9 fetches and 1 each of Island, Mountain, Swamp; the candidate cuts Exotic Orchard and Takenuma and adds the Soporific Springs and Fell Mire MDFCs.
- Mana: Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone (cut), Dimir/Izzet/Rakdos Signets, three Talismans.
- Equipment (20 -> 21): Basilisk Collar, Blackblade Reforged, Blade of the Bloodchief, Brotherhood Regalia, Commander's Plate, Grafted Exoskeleton, Inquisitor's Flail, Mask of Memory, Mithril Coat, Quietus Spike, Robe of the Archmagi, Scythe of the Wretched, Shadowspear, Swiftfoot Boots, Sword of Feast and Famine, Sword of Fire and Ice, Tarrian's Soulcleaver, The Reaver Cleaver, Thornbite Staff, Trailblazer's Boots; Lizard Blades is new.
- Garza-sourced damage: Fall of the Hammer, Soul's Fire, Chandra's Ignition, Nova Flame; Giantfall is new.
- Payoffs and draw: Kediss, Curiosity, Rhystic Study, Jeska, Thrice Reborn, Jeska's Will, The Ozolith, Aggravated Assault, Hatred, Psychotic Fury.
- Interaction and protection: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Terminate, Pongify, Rapid Hybridization (cut), Feed the Swarm, Deadly Rollick, Sheoldred's Edict, Toxic Deluge, Slip Out the Back; Sink into Stupor and Fell the Profane are new.
- Tutors: Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Lands 38 -> 36 plus two MDFC lands (Soporific Springs U, Fell Mire B). U/B/R land sources (fetches and rainbow lands counted for each colour) 25/27/24 -> 25/26/23 with MDFC back faces counted. Exact hypergeometric Garza castability (lands, Ancient Tomb as 2, Sol Ring, Mana Vault/Grim Monolith, Signets/Talismans/Arcane Signet/Fellwar; colours assumed met): by turn 4/5/6 on the play 0.1876/0.3093/0.4724 -> 0.1769/0.2882/0.4451 with MDFCs played as lands (0.1649/0.2669/0.4073 if never). Average nonland MV 2.213 -> 2.270; creatures besides Garza 1 -> 2 (Kediss; Lizard Blades while unattached).
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Cavern of Souls; Sink into Stupor is new (also hits uncounterable spells). Removal: Terminate, Pongify, Feed the Swarm, Deadly Rollick, Sheoldred's Edict, Chaos Warp, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Fall of the Hammer, Soul's Fire, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Chandra's Ignition, Nova Flame; Giantfall and Fell the Profane are new; Rapid Hybridization is cut. Protection: Swiftfoot Boots, Mithril Coat, Commander's Plate, Shadowspear, Slip Out the Back, Plaza of Heroes. Weak points: a 7-mana commander with commander tax; edicts when Garza is the only creature; equipment hate; removal between strike steps.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Garza Zol general absent, upgraded absent, optimized absent; cEDH page has no card data; live Scryfall batch; OFF-RANKING (absent from every Garza EDHREC page)
material_candidates.role: {1}{R} 1/1 Artifact Creature — Equipment Lizard with double strike; equipped creature has double strike; reconfigure {2} (sorcery speed; not a creature while attached).
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Fellwar Stone, a 2-mana rock (EDHREC 47/128, synergy 0.01). Plain owner RETAIN, not an explicit keep. Cost: Garza castable by turn 6 on the play 0.4724 -> 0.4451 in the candidate (MDFCs as lands), part of which is this rock.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: The exact role Pass C asked to test (permanent double strike vs Inquisitor's Flail). Bounded test: double strike doubles every per-hit Garza trigger: 2 Garza draws, 6 Curiosity draws with Kediss at a 3-opponent table, Quietus Spike from 40 to 6 (vs 15 with Flail), Robe of the Archmagi and both Swords trigger twice. With the first-strike step Garza kills a 5/5 vanilla, a 3/3 deathtouch or a 4/4 double striker and survives, gaining a counter between steps; bare or Flail Garza dies to those blocks. Kept beside Flail it makes 24 commander damage at power 6 in one hit (lethal).
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: A 1/1 double-strike creature while unattached dies to sweepers including our own Toxic Deluge; reconfigure is not an equip ability; removal between the two strike steps loses the second hit. Psychotic Fury already gives one-shot double strike.
material_candidates.reason: Pass C's own NEEDS TESTING request was run as a finite ledger; double strike beat Flail on draws, Spike, survival and blocker kills, and Lizard Blades is the cheaper (2+2 vs 3+2) double-strike piece. The rock cut costs castability; the keep-Fellwar/cut-Flail and Fireshrieker alternatives are staged.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Four one-for-one swaps: Lizard Blades for Fellwar Stone, Giantfall for Rapid Hybridization, Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs for Exotic Orchard and Fell the Profane // Fell Mire for Takenuma, Abandoned Mire. Losses: one 2-mana rock (Garza castable by turn 6 on the play 0.4724 -> 0.4451 with MDFCs as lands), one-mana creature removal that works without a creature, Exotic Orchard's rainbow mana and Takenuma's channel recursion; B/R land sources 27/24 -> 26/23; two lands now cost 3 life to enter untapped. No owner keep or owner addition is cut.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Staged four-swap with Fireshrieker instead of Lizard Blades: same combat rows, one more setup mana, not a creature.
Staged four-swap keeping Fellwar Stone and cutting Inquisitor's Flail: baseline castability, loses the 4x one-hit kill.
Staged five-swap over the owner-added Nova Flame: rejected, not counted.
Staged five-swap adding Hammer of Nazahn over a rock: rejected on castability.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C NEEDS TESTING (+Fireshrieker / -Inquisitor's Flail) was run as a bounded finite combat ledger (no RNG): 5 equipment states x 8 blocker states x 3 configs, plus Kediss/Curiosity, Quietus Spike, infect, removal-between-steps and one-hit lethal rows. Double strike equals Flail's 10 damage unblocked, doubles draws and Spike, and survives non-first-strike 5/5, 3/3 deathtouch and 4/4 double-strike blockers that kill bare or Flail Garza; Flail alone wins only when removal lands between strike steps (10 vs 5 damage). The exact Pass C list is staged; the primary uses the cheaper Lizard Blades and keeps Flail. Pass C's other named cuts (Robe of the Archmagi, Quietus Spike) multiply with double strike and are not cut. Matched-game win rates were not run: no validated Garza game model exists.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The baseline's permanent damage doubler (Inquisitor's Flail) also doubles damage dealt to Garza and gives one trigger per hit, while the deck's payoffs (Garza's draw, Curiosity, Kediss, Quietus Spike, Robe, both Swords) are all per-hit. Several mana-base slots (Exotic Orchard, Takenuma) and one removal spell (Rapid Hybridization) do nothing Garza-specific.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Four genuine swaps: Lizard Blades for Fellwar Stone (permanent double strike), Giantfall for Rapid Hybridization (Garza-sourced removal plus artifact mode), Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs for Exotic Orchard and Fell the Profane // Fell Mire for Takenuma, Abandoned Mire (lands that are also interaction). A fifth was not found without cutting an owner keep or addition on unclear evidence (Nibelheim Aflame over Nova Flame) or re-adding an owner-removed class (Fire Whip), so the deck is held as research only.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commander first, then lines alphabetically; every card 1x. Four substitutions against the canonical source. 36 lands plus two MDFC lands; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (99 library + 1 commander).

The five-swap owner-presentation floor is not met without padding: the only fifth candidates either cut the owner's explicit Nova Flame addition on evidence that does not clearly beat the owner's stated reason (Nibelheim Aflame), cut an owner-kept interaction piece (Toxic Deluge), re-add an owner-removed pinger class (Fire Whip) or lower castability for an unclear gain (Hammer of Nazahn).
